name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the ongoing persecution of Christians in Nigeria, notably the Kawel village massacre
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns violence against civilians in Kawel village in Nigeria's Plateau state, where an armed attack in June 2026 killed many people from the local Christian community. It calls on Nigerian authorities to investigate the massacre properly, bring those responsible to justice, and end impunity. It also asks Nigeria to do more against armed groups, improve early warning and protection of civilians, and address the land, ethnic, religious and climate pressures behind the wider violence in the Middle Belt region.

- The Parliament asks Nigeria to investigate the Kawel killings and prosecute those responsible; nothing changes in law.
- It affects Nigeria's federal and state authorities, Christian communities and displaced people in the Middle Belt.
- Next, the resolution is sent to the European Union's institutions and to Nigeria's government and parliament.
